glosses: OK, so-so (in answer to the question, "как дела?" ("How are you?"), the response "потихоньку"—"OK" or "I'm getting along okay"—implies that things could be better and could be worse)

examples.text: Том и Мэри потихоньку улизнули из комнаты.
examples.en: Tom and Mary quietly slipped out of the room.
